description: Draw today's deity card from Mythsensus's 1,069-deity collection. Deterministic given (birth date, current date) — the same chart on the same day always draws the same deity. Higher Cosmic Score chart tiers are biased to draw rarer-tier deities. Returns deity name, mythology origin (Hindu, Norse, Yoruba, etc.), tier (Common→Mythic), and today's message. This is a simplified version of the website daily blessing.

date.description: Date to draw for, YYYY-MM-DD (optional; defaults to today)

name: daily_blessing
